How Our Service Works

Walk-ins are welcome for selected services. For ceramic coating, PPF, window tint, and larger detailing jobs, calling ahead is recommended.

01

Choose a Service

Browse our services and choose the right care option for your vehicle.

02

Contact Us Or Visit Our Shop

Call ahead or bring your vehicle to the shop. We suggest calling us before your visit to check availability, service details, and the best time to bring your vehicle in.

03

Vehicle Inspection & Service Confirmation

We inspect your vehicle, explain the recommended work, provide the estimated cost, and let you know the expected completion time.

04

Pick Up Your Vehicle

Once your service is completed, we’ll contact you to pick up your vehicle, review the work, and complete the payment.

Service Packages & Pricing

Pricing depends on your vehicle size, condition, and the level of service required. Contact us for an accurate quote.

Training & Skill Development

At HyperAuto Care, you will learn from experts who have years of hands-on experience in car detailing, paint protection, and vehicle care.

Each training area is guided by specialists with deep knowledge in their field, helping you learn the right techniques, tools, and working methods used in professional detailing.

What You Will Get From HyperAuto Care Training
Learn From Industry Experts

Work directly with experienced detailing professionals who share practical knowledge and real-world techniques from their daily work.

Hands-On Practice With Professional Guidance

Practice real detailing processes on vehicles with step-by-step guidance from our experienced team.

Use Professional Equipment For Free

All necessary tools and equipment are provided during training, allowing you to focus on learning and improving your skills.

Learn Real Workshop Experience

Understand professional workflows, customer requirements, and quality standards used in an actual detailing garage.

Build Your Career Opportunity

Students who demonstrate strong skills and commitment may have the opportunity to work with HyperAuto Care after completing training.

Start Your Detailing Journey With HyperAuto Care
